selection: All configurations/ages/methods/updates fixed before outcomes; retain duplicates, errors, natural regressions and inconclusive outcomes. Proof selection independent of quality.
replication_unit: Four dataset/seed/k split configurations. Eight deployed models and two representations share these splits; updates/ranks/scopes are paired, not independent replications.
scope: Numerical confirmation first. These are new fits on existing public source datasets, not new datasets or production logs. Actual proof timings are a separate campaign.
